title: Remarks at South Vernon, Massachusetts
note: The catalog record says Mount Vernon; the typed heading of the document reads South Vernon, Mass.
paragraphs: I am very glad to see you and to be greeted upon my return to Massachusetts by you. I enjoyed being in Massachusetts when I was here before, and I am glad to be back again.
